# Additional offline runtimes

- **Jump3r 1.0.5**, Java LAME port, LGPL-2.1-or-later. Maven `de.sciss:jump3r:1.0.5`; original corresponding Java sources are included as `jump3r-1.0.5-sources.jar`. License and attribution are in APK assets `licenses/Jump3r-LGPL-2.1.txt`. This GPL-3.0-or-later application builds the encoder from that unmodified artifact; `Mp3Export.java` is our adapter, using no desktop Java Sound API. Rebuild the APK to replace the library. Upstream: https://git.iem.at/sciss/jump3r . Credits: L.A.M.E. project, Ken Händel, Vadym Vikulin, Hanns Holger Rutz.
- **ONNX Runtime Android 1.31.0**, MIT, Maven `com.microsoft.onnxruntime:onnxruntime-android:1.31.0`. Upstream https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.31.0 . Only ARM64 is bundled. `scripts/prepare-tiny-runtime.py` verifies the original AAR hash and reproduces our library-name-only changes. `libtinyort.so` is the new runtime; its JNI dependency and Java loader constant use that name. ELF code and segment offsets are unchanged. This avoids replacing the existing Piper/sherpa runtime, which requires `OrtGetApiBase@VERS_1.17.1`; the new Java JNI requires `VERS_1.31.0`. The existing Piper binaries remain byte-for-byte unchanged. MIT license included in APK assets.
- **Indic Tiny Telugu** by Sulabh Katiyar, pinned revision `55cfc683fafb55326a0a01932a3b2bb4374c4fc0`: https://huggingface.co/sulabhkatiyar/indic-tiny-tts-telugu . Acoustic graphs CC BY 4.0; Python reference code MIT; Vocos vocoder MIT. Rasa dataset by AI4Bharat (Praveen Srinivasa Varadhan, Ashwin Sankar, Giri Raju, Mitesh M. Khapra, INTERSPEECH 2024), CC BY 4.0. Full upstream license is in APK assets `licenses/IndicTiny-LICENSE.md`. `TinyVoice.java` ports the inference pipeline; strict supported-character validation replaces the larger Python multilingual normalizer. Unsupported text fails explicitly instead of dropping characters. No weights are bundled; three pinned verified graphs are downloaded once and shared by both speakers.
